task: Implemented MCP protocol types following get-pattern search for mcp-protocol json-rpc and serde serialization rust
critique: Found useful patterns: arch-mcp-http-transport (ADR-001), arch-mcp-response-format (ADR-005), sample-rust-error-handling. Patterns provided good context for response format structure but no existing MCP protocol type implementation existed. Used ADR-005 response format structure as guide for ToolResponse design with success flag and isError. Created standalone types without mcp-sdk dependency as specified in dp-005 architecture.

task: Implemented HTTP server layer with axum following arch-mcp-http-transport pattern
critique: Found arch-mcp-http-transport pattern which confirmed axum framework and route structure (POST /mcp, GET /health). Pattern was helpful but needed to solve arrow/chrono version conflict independently. Also found existing scaffolding files in ndp-mcp-server which had incomplete implementations.

task: Used arch-mcp-http-transport, arch-bronze-storage-trait, and arch-domain-adapter-pattern patterns to create ndp-mcp-server crate structure
critique: Patterns were very helpful. arch-mcp-http-transport confirmed HTTP POST transport with axum. arch-bronze-storage-trait defined the BronzeStorage abstraction pattern. arch-domain-adapter-pattern provided the hexagonal architecture approach for ports and adapters.

task: Implemented LocalParquetStorage for Bronze layer Parquet access
critique: ADR-002 BronzeStorage trait pattern was helpful. Hive-style partition discovery (year/month/day descending) works well. Unit tests with tempfile fixtures verify the implementation correctly. The existing traits.rs and types.rs defined the interface clearly.

task: Implemented EtcdConfigStore for MCP server using retrieved patterns
critique: Retrieved patterns were very helpful. arch-mcp-etcd-config pattern provided the ADR context for fail-fast design and ConfigStore trait. config-etcd-pattern provided the key structure and architecture patterns. arch-domain-adapter-pattern guided the trait-based abstraction design. The implementation followed Domain Adapter pattern exactly. No gaps found - patterns were complete.

task: Implemented BronzeStorage and ConfigStore traits with mockall support following Domain Adapter pattern
critique: arch-bronze-storage-trait pattern was helpful - it confirmed the trait design approach. However, existing mcp tools code uses different method signatures than the new traits. The core traits, types, and error handling are complete and follow London School TDD with comprehensive mock-based tests. Integration with existing MCP handler code requires additional adaptation work.
